assumptions: PE-JEPA network, SIGReg, student encoder and CJTS trainer code (lejepa/, rsl_rl/, scripts/train.py) were not supplied; their description is taken from the paper only and not verified against code.

The active sub-terrain dictionary PARKOUR_TERRAINS_CFG, the Mid360 ray pattern (RaySphericalSlicePatternCfg), the terrain generator goal layouts, and go2_loco_events.py were not supplied; mode-to-terrain mapping for non-direct terrains is inferred from the direct list plus the paper's statement that Boxes and Steps use waypoints.

lejepa license is assumed CC BY-NC per the task contract; no license file for lejepa, the rsl_rl fork, go2_rl_robotlab or the dataset was supplied, so these are unverified. Upstream RSL-RL is assumed BSD-3.
Paper says 5 accumulated scans at 20 Hz; code stacks 10 raycaster frames at 50 Hz env rate (about 0.2 s window). Treated as the same design with a different frame rate, not verified.
Paper says the 2.0x1.5 m height map is centered on the robot; code offsets the scanner 0.4 m forward. Code is taken as the implemented behavior.
Paper describes occlusion masks as circles and rectangles; code adds squares, trapezoids and a Perlin hole level. Code is taken as implemented behavior.
Omnidirectional heading offset on flat terrain is overwritten to zero in the committed code (go2_loco_env.py:1103), so waypoint mode always faces the goal; assumed intentional for this commit.
Action delay 0-20 ms from paper Tab IV is assumed to be implemented in the unsupplied events/actuator code.
Training budget on 2x RTX 5080 16 GB is not estimated; the paper's 12 h figure is for one RTX 6000 Pro with 4096 envs and a ray-cast LiDAR, and memory feasibility at 4096 envs on 16 GB is unverified.
No claim of scientific equivalence or verification is made; everything is extracted from supplied text.
